steps.en: After transfer to State Courts, each record is marked successful or failed
steps.id: Setelah file di-interface ke State Courts, OCMS menandai tiap record sukses atau gagal
steps.why_en: No success or failure is recorded per court record.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada status sukses/gagal per record pengadilan.

steps.en: OCMS generates a summary report of court application records that were interfaced successfully
steps.id: OCMS membuat summary report record court application yang sukses di-interface
steps.why_en: The success report is only a menu placeholder with no content.
steps.why_id: Laporan sukses hanya placeholder menu tanpa isi.

steps.en: OCMS generates a summary report of records that failed to interface, with the errors
steps.id: OCMS membuat summary report record yang gagal di-interface beserta error-nya
steps.why_en: The failure report with errors does not exist.
steps.why_id: Laporan gagal beserta errornya tidak ada.

steps.en: The officer opens the report from the Report menu to see successful/failed records
steps.id: Petugas membuka report dari menu Report untuk melihat record sukses/gagal
steps.why_en: An officer cannot open any court application report.
steps.why_id: Petugas tidak bisa membuka laporan court application apa pun.
